title: Stripe button
description: Small-cornered rectangular button: indigo fill, white with a soft shadow, hairline outline, a ghost for dark bands, or a plain link. The chevron after the label grows a stem and nudges right on hover.
notes: also exports HoverArrow, the hover chevron on its own (put it inside a `group`)
name: stripe-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: indigo fill · white: white fill with indigo text and a soft shadow ·
outline: hairline border with indigo text · ghost: hairline border in the text colour
(for dark bands) · link: plain indigo text

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 40px tall, 14px text (headers) · md: 48px tall, 16px text

props.name: arrow
props.description: the small chevron after the label that grows a stem on hover

props.name: fullOnMobile
props.description: stretch to the full width on phones (as the original's CTAs do)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: label for screen readers when the visible label is not enough
